description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notifications Nos. 991, of  09.12.2016  992 of  15.12.2016 and 994 of 20.12.2016 - order made section 32, read with section 25 was passed by Parliament on 22.06.2017
reasoning: This gazette content announces that specific Excise Notifications (No. 991, 992, and 994) issued under the Excise Ordinance have been passed by parliament. It deals with regulatory matters, specifically the approval of statutory instruments related to excise regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial activities, elections, public service, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories.
